concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paypay-android-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 PayPay Android Drop-in Sessions/Advanced add-on for Sessions-only Checkout v68+, Advanced redirect prerequisite, no extra PayPay fields, DGFT TEST simulator and LIVE activated-app/Japan-local-IP condition; outcome remains unproven.
warnings: Sessions lists Checkout API v68+; the Advanced section does not provide its own version minimum.
The Sessions section omits an explicit redirect prerequisite, whereas Advanced states action.type redirect; both TEST branches describe redirection to DGFT simulator.
No additional PayPay-specific parameters does not remove existing base-flow request, return or result-verification requirements.
DGFT TEST simulator and Customer Area status inspection are not LIVE eligibility, authorization, capture or settlement proof.
